Siding Replacement in Columbus, OH
Professional Siding Replacement Services in Columbus, Ohio

Your home deserves more than just any siding on its exterior. Whether you're updating aging vinyl, replacing storm-damaged panels, or installing a completely new siding system on your existing home, the quality of that replacement determines everything. How long your siding lasts. How well it protects your belongings. How much you spend on energy bills. How your home looks from the street. One professional replacement done right protects your family and your investment for decades. One careless installation creates problems you'll fight for years.

When you're ready to replace your siding, you face dozens of decisions that seem overwhelming. Which materials actually perform well in Central Ohio's climate? How much insulation does your home really need? What underlayment provides real protection? Should you upgrade your house wrap? Do you need moisture barriers, and if so, where? These aren't just technical details. They're the difference between siding that performs beautifully for 25 years and panels that fail in year seven.
Why Columbus Homeowners Need Reliable Siding Replacement

Here's what separates professional siding replacement from amateur work. The materials themselves are only half the equation. How those materials get installed matters just as much as which brand you choose. We've torn off countless siding panels that used premium materials but failed early because someone rushed the installation, skipped critical steps, or didn't understand proper flashing techniques.

Central Ohio's weather demands more from your siding than most people realize. Spring hailstorms test every panel's impact resistance. Summer heat cycles expand and contract materials thousands of times. Fall windstorms challenge every fastener's holding power. Winter ice and freeze-thaw cycles push moisture into gaps where poor installation leaves vulnerabilities. Your siding replacement needs to handle all of this, year after year, without compromise.

Picture this common scenario. You hired the lowest bidder to replace your siding last year. Everything looked fine when they finished. But now you're noticing problems. Small moisture intrusion around your windows during heavy rain. Panels warping at the edges on hot days. Faded streaks appearing where moisture gets trapped under improperly installed trim. Your beautiful new siding is failing, and the company that installed it stopped returning your calls months ago.
Columbus's Most Trusted Siding Replacement Services

Coldstream Exteriors has spent over 25 years replacing siding that performs exactly as it should. We specialize in professional siding replacement services that solve problems before they start instead of creating issues you'll fight later. We're not here to rush through your project and move to the next job. We're here to give you properly installed siding with quality materials, experienced installation crews, and guarantees that actually mean something.
Expert Siding Replacement for Every Situation

Many Columbus homeowners come to us with different replacement needs. Maybe you're finally updating that original vinyl siding from when your home was built. Frequently Asked Questions About Siding Replacement in Columbus
How much does siding replacement cost in Columbus?

Most Columbus siding replacements range from $8,500 to $18,000, depending on your home's size, siding material, and complexity. A typical 2,000 square foot home with vinyl siding averages $11,000-$14,000. Premium materials like fiber cement or engineered wood typically cost $15,000-$25,000. We provide detailed written estimates after your free consultation, and you pay nothing until installation is 100% complete.
How long does siding replacement take in Columbus?

Most residential siding replacements take 3-7 days with our experienced crews. Simple ranch homes can often be completed in 2-3 days, while larger two-story homes with complex trim work typically take 5-7 days. Weather conditions can affect the timeline, and we'll keep you informed throughout the process.
What siding materials do you recommend for Columbus homes?

Vinyl siding remains the most popular choice for Columbus homes, offering 20-30 years of durability with excellent weather resistance. Fiber cement siding provides superior longevity (40-50 years) and exceptional impact resistance at a higher upfront cost. During your consultation, we show you samples and explain which materials work best for your home and budget.
Do you handle siding replacement for storm damage claims?

Yes, we work with homeowners and insurance companies on storm damage siding replacement throughout Columbus. We document all damage thoroughly, coordinate with your adjuster, and ensure your claim covers the full scope of necessary repairs.
Can you install new siding over my existing panels?

While it's technically possible in some situations, we rarely recommend it. Complete tear-off and reinstallation lets us inspect your sheathing, replace damaged wood, ensure proper moisture barriers, and install new house wrap. This approach delivers better long-term performance and allows full manufacturer warranties.
What makes Coldstream Exteriors different from other Columbus siding companies?

You pay nothing until your siding replacement is 100% complete and you're satisfied. No deposit, no progress payments, no financial risk. We've earned our BBB A+ rating and 4.9 stars from 400+ customers by treating Columbus homeowners right for over 25 years.
How do I prepare my home for siding replacement?

We handle most preparation, but homeowners should move vehicles out of the driveway, relocate outdoor furniture and grills away from the house, trim back shrubs and bushes near exterior walls, and remove items from walls inside that might fall from vibration. We'll provide a complete preparation checklist before we start.
